summary_en: Buffalo executed treasury stock acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 at 3,180 yen per share for 1 million shares (4.21% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) totaling 3.18 billion yen on November 16, 2026, with tender offer for up to 3 million shares and market purchases planned through April 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Treasury Stock Acquisition via ToSTNeT-3, Public Tender Offer, and Market Purchase
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Buffalo's board of directors approved the execution of treasury stock acquisition through multiple methods. The first execution was conducted via ToSTNeT-3 on November 16, 2026, at the fixed price of 3,180 yen per share (the November 13 closing price), acquiring 1 million shares totaling 3.18 billion yen. This represents 4.21% of issued shares excluding treasury stock.

The acquisition is part of a broader three-pronged program: the ToSTNeT-3 block transaction detailed above, a tender offer planned for up to 3 million shares from November 19 through December 17, 2026, and market purchases of up to 4 million shares from January 14 through April 30, 2027, subject to a maximum aggregate amount of 14 billion yen across all three methods. The company specifically arranged for the ToSTNeT-3 transaction with ECM Master Fund (managed by Effissimo Capital Management), signaling coordination with a significant shareholder.

The board cited multiple objectives: enhancement of shareholder returns, balance sheet optimization, achievement of a consolidated ROE target of 15% or above, maintenance of stable dividend payments at 30–40% payout ratio, and continued status as a non-foreign investor under Japan's Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Law. The combination of methods was designed to ensure adequate participation opportunities for general shareholders while securing the desired acquisition from strategic holders.
